changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE users_new ( id TEXT NOT NULL, username TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT, password TEXT, roles TEXT, user_origin TEXT NOT NULL, last_login_at TEXT, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', job_title TEXT, organizational_unit TEXT, CONSTRAINT pk_users PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_users_username UNIQUE (username), CONSTRAINT uq_users_email UNIQUE (email), CONSTRAINT ck_users_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')) );

INSERT INTO users_new (id, username, email, password, roles, user_origin, last_login_at, first_name, last_name, status, job_title, organizational_unit) SELECT id, username, email, password, roles, user_origin, last_login_at, first_name, last_name, status, job_title, organizational_unit FROM users;
ALTER TABLE users_new RENAME TO users;
